commits.subject: docs: update reports skill for v0.4.7 (play_balance, wht_statements, fixed subscriptions prefix)
commits.summary: The skill docs added `play_balance` and `wht_statements` financial report types and changed the subscriptions stats path to `financial-stats/subscriptions/`.

commits.subject: fix: support both bucket prefixes and simplify output format
commits.summary: The skill docs updated the bucket naming guidance to allow either `pubsite_prod_rev_<id>` or `pubsite_prod_<id>` and simplified the JSON output examples to use `bucket`.

commits.subject: fix: rename --developer to --bucket-id in reports download skill
commits.summary: The skill docs renamed the report bucket argument from `--developer` to `--bucket-id` and updated the guidance and examples to use the GCS bucket ID or URI.

commits.subject: docs: clarify GCS developer ID differs from Play Console URL ID
commits.summary: The skill docs clarified that reports use the GCS developer ID from the Download reports Cloud Storage URI, not the Play Console URL ID.

commits.subject: feat: add gplay-reports-download skill and update README
commits.summary: The patch added the `gplay-reports-download` skill documentation for listing and downloading Google Play financial and statistics reports from GCS buckets.
